description: Five-intent v2 sample for src/kernel/score.ts and the v2 loader (contracts.md@rev1 §1). Rows: new-feature and llm declare phrases, verb_object, negative and exemplars and keep their v1 signals; adr is the §1.4 example verbatim; bug is a v1-only row (signals only, phrases derived at weight 1); frontend declares phrases without signals and carries a routing domain for the path feature. Misroute 1 ('create a mod ...') must not rank llm first; misroute 2 ('create a plan to replace our routing ...') must rank adr above new-feature.

intents.title: New feature / multi-file change
intents.note: New behavior with no more-specific row; a more specific matching row suppresses this one.
exemplars: add a checkout endpoint with payment validation
implement password reset across api and web

intents.title: Bug / unexpected behavior
intents.note: v1-only row: no v2 field, so phrases derive from signals at weight 1.
